name: connection.set
description: Turns one of a brand's connections on or off, as the connect sheet does. Pinterest follows the brand's linked account instead (account.link, account.board); the real sign-ins for Meta and TikTok are not wired to this yet.
sql: insert into brandbase.connections as k (brand_id, key, status) values (:brand, :key, :status) on conflict (brand_id, key) do update set status = excluded.status, updated_at = now() returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(k)) as result
